scope: Offline selected implementation-ready read paths and semantic limits. No car, ADB, network, credentials, extraction, product edits or commits. Full registry coverage belongs to stream-coverage-20261021.json.

constraints: Use observed native int/float type independently from declaration Java type. Shell scalar Binder5/7 is historical; byte arrays require real typed SDK buffer parcel.
No scalar-only transact10/12; historical malformed buffer requests crashed autoservice.
App-UID BYDAUTO permissions are independent. All retained scalar sweep values were shell; no ordinary app acceptance asserted.

generic_raw_typed_event.code: device.registerListener(IBYDAutoListener, new int[]{nativeFid}); implement onDataEventChanged(eventType,BYDAutoEventValue), retain intValue/doubleValue/bufferDataValue plus receive timestamp; unregister on teardown; main Looper must run.
constraints: Static subscription API proof only; rates, delivery, initial replay, installed device fields and app permissions not qualified per channel.
Typed listener adapters can omit newer fields; generic event forwarding is independently present.

radar_sdk_buffers.decoder: selector1: status[i%2][i/2]=(signed Java byte)buffer[i]; selector2: distance[j]=(signed Java byte)buffer[2*j+1]. RSE/RCS strips4-byte prefix before checking16.
constraints: Eight two-byte records do not establish ordering equivalence to nine scalar areas.
SDK sign-extends bytes; preserve original octets to avoid losing128..255.
Neither layout supplies a proven physical-ECU binding or cm scale.
Opaque buffer; payload schema not recovered here. Generic collision event is not SRS ECU telemetry or restraint-state ownership.
Old concrete temperature/humidity getters use literal classic selectors796311/740567, not new current-car3B400010/008. Do not substitute by name.
Jadx typed temperature/humidity callbacks show discarded getDoubleValue and literal0; without bytecode audit treat this adapter as ambiguous. Generic onDataEventChanged preserves doubleValue.
Windshield surface temperature and humidity must be read by their resolved current IDs; unit and quality remain separate.

DiCar_property_key_only_native_resolutio.code: CarPropertyUtils.getCarProperty(context, propertyKey) -> ICarPropertyService.getProperty(propertyKey); preserve Response.status and typed CarPropertyValue.
constraints: A declaration with no resolved native FID is not a runnable native command. The stock mapper may fail or use a compatibility fallback; no identity equality is assumed.
The service and BYDAUTO read permissions still apply. No ordinary application UID acceptance is asserted.

familyCoverage.limits: Measured cabin/outside candidates and zone-target distinction; no room/coolant equivalence.
Power, compressor mode, fan level and defrost feedback are operating states, not compressor RPM or pressure.
Declared averages, compressor/PTC consumption and water-pump duty have no resolved native ID in this corpus. Coolant remaining service life is not a coolant temperature/level sensor.
Current native channels plus raw-event subscription; sensor calibration/units and windshield physical location are only as named, not physical ECU attribution.
Ordinal versus numeric channels separated.
Nine scalar areas; eight bulk slots;1023 distances currently unqualified.
Sixteen named sections are not sixteen proven ultrasonic probes.
Function status/fault/abort fields with no source proven physical mapping to712/7F2/door SDR.
Object coordinate/type/direction raw values; engineering coordinates, units, validity and target-index lifetime unresolved.
Four pressure paths and rotating-context aggregate; temperature classic aliases are no-data, no four-wheel temperature reconstruction.
Open/closed/windows percent/sunroof feedback; no assumed720/721/etc binding.
